entities.summary: Emanuel Navarrete Martínez is a Mexican professional boxer. He is a three-division world champion, having held the unified International Boxing Federation (IBF) and World Boxing Organization (WBO) junior lightweight title since February 2026. He also previously held the WBO junior featherweight title from 2018 to 2020 and the WBO featherweight title from 2020 to 2023.
